name: Lasso
tagline: Herd a mixed flock with your dog, then rope one color at a time.
description: Your finger is a sheepdog and the flock runs from it. Push the sheep apart by color, then draw a rope loop around a single color to pen them. Each day is a short round with a goal before sunset, and every day adds a new twist: rams, lambs, mud, a wolf, dusk, grey sheep, rocks and hedges, then spotted sheep. Remix days put more obstacles in the field each day.

build.notes: Days 7 to 9 add grey sheep, rocks and hedges, and spotted sheep. Remix days start at day 10 and add an obstacle each day.

what_to_test.title: Herding feel
what_to_test.details: Does pushing sheep with the dog feel controllable, or do they scatter randomly?

what_to_test.title: Drawing the rope
what_to_test.details: Is it clear how to close a loop? Tell us if loops failed when you thought they should work.

what_to_test.title: More colors and obstacles
what_to_test.details: From day 7: can you tell grey and spotted sheep apart at a glance? Do rocks and hedges help you corner sheep, or just get in the way?

what_to_test.title: Which day is the wall?
what_to_test.details: Note the first day you had to retry and what beat you: time, the field filling up, or a twist.

known_issues: Placeholder art and sound: shapes and synthesized tones only.
Revive and ad-break buttons are stand-ins. No real ads play.
Progress is saved in this browser only.
Day goals have not been tuned against real play yet.
On iPhone, sound stays muted while the silent switch is on.
